onboarding.title: Setup Wizard
onboarding.subtitle: Get started with Daily Worklog in a few quick steps
onboarding.stepWelcomeDescription: Daily Worklog is a fast, lightweight desktop application designed to track your daily achievements, manage action items with Kanban boards, build daily routines, and automatically generate comprehensive weekly & monthly executive reports.
onboarding.stepWelcomeFeature1Desc: You own all your data. Everything is saved in standard plain-text markdown (.md) files that you can edit with any tool or sync with any cloud provider.
onboarding.stepWelcomeFeature2Desc: Write effortlessly with split/live markdown preview, interactive task checkboxes, code blocks, and dynamic date templates.
onboarding.stepWelcomeFeature3Desc: Instantly consolidate your daily logs into executive weekly and monthly summaries, and track recurring daily routine habits.
onboarding.stepVaultDescription: The Vault is the folder on your computer where all your daily notes, tasks, images, and attachments are stored.
onboarding.stepVaultWhyTitle: Why is this the most important setting?
onboarding.stepVaultWhyDesc: Your notes never live in a closed database or remote cloud server. Choosing a dedicated local folder (like Documents, Dropbox, iCloud, or a Git repository) gives you full control and privacy over your files.
onboarding.stepLanguageDescription: Select your preferred language and choose how date tokens appear in your note templates.
onboarding.languageHelp: Switch between English and Spanish seamlessly. All interface menus and dates adapt instantly.
onboarding.dateFormatHelp: Controls how the date variable is formatted when creating daily notes or inserting templates.
onboarding.stepScheduleDescription: Define how your work week starts. This determines how weekly summaries and reporting periods are calculated.
onboarding.weekStartHelp: For example, selecting Monday groups Monday through Sunday together in your weekly worklog reports.
onboarding.stepEditorDescription: Configure how your work is saved and style the visual look of the application.
onboarding.autoSaveDescription: Automatically saves your daily notes and task boards while typing without having to press save manually.
onboarding.themeColorDesc: Pick an accent color that suits your style.
onboarding.colorSchemeDesc: Choose light, dark, or follow your operating system appearance.
onboarding.stepFinishSubtitle: Your Daily Worklog workspace is configured and ready.
onboarding.stepFinishSettingsNoticeDesc: There are many other advanced settings you can adjust anytime on the Settings page to fulfill your exact workflow needs:
onboarding.settingsNoticeRoutines: Recurring Daily Habit Routines & Quick Links
onboarding.settingsNoticeArchiving: Old Task Auto-Archiving & Editor Font Size
onboarding.settingsNoticeRevisit: You can also re-run this setup wizard anytime from the Settings window.

areas.title: Areas & Projects
areas.areaExplanation: Permanent domain of ongoing responsibility without end date or progress bar (e.g. Webcast, VC, ASR).
areas.projectExplanation: Concrete effort with a specific goal, deadline, and progress tracking inside an Area (e.g. Wowza Migration).
areas.inheritanceExplanation: Tasks created inside an Area or Project automatically inherit their context and tags without cluttering the task title.
